description: Set up, list or cancel ONGOING trackers and alerts that watch a stock, item or ticket price or availability and notify later when a condition is met or on a schedule. A one-off 'what is it now' lookup is NOT tracking.
examples: Alert me when Nvidia drops below 120
Tell me when concert tickets under 100 dollars become available
Track the price of this laptop and tell me if it goes below 800
Notify me every morning with the S&P 500 close
Let me know when the new iPhone is in stock
Watch flights to Chicago and tell me if they get cheaper
Send me a daily update on Tesla's stock price
Remind me if the gas price drops below 3 dollars
What trackers do I have running?
Check the price of this item every day
Message me when the ticket resale price falls
negatives: What's Nvidia trading at this minute?
Turn on the porch light at sunset
continuations: also tell me if it goes above 150
